question:
The following Venn diagram shows the number of students who play different games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d1f3a08571485112107859e839f2c36ceb571a290eb2e80522241260ef5b066.png] 

How many students are playing cricket, football and hockey?
solution:
The students who play cricket, football and hockey are represented by the shaded part in the given Venn diagram:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e379d815925f9744d061a656c5d979315f288933ac086486cde49c9676759d7.png] 

So, **the number of students playing cricket, football and hockey = 2**

Hence, the correct answer s **"2"**.
